Astra is worth the fuss. We’re still keeping Fable.

For weeks, OpenAI has been previewing Astra’s math results and explaining why its cybersecurity capabilities required stronger safeguards https://every.. Now GPT-6 Astra is out, billed as the company’s most intelligent model yet.

Astra gave us writing, consulting work, and designs we wanted to keep. Dan Shipper https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiVmliZSBDaGVjazogR1BULTYgQXN0cmEgSXMgYSBCaWcgVXBncmFkZSBXaXRoIFNvbWUgQmFkIEhhYml0cyIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQ0NjcsInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InByb21vIiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9AZGFuc2hpcHBlciIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjo3fQ== is enthusiastic about its computer use—operating software through the interface. But a beautiful first result isn’t always a finished product. Fable 5.1 still did better on the complicated apps we tested. Astra also had a habit of adding copy and interface elements the task didn’t need.
